missed.text: The Helix data stays under embargo until 30 June 2027, nothing can be published before then.
If the biosafety approval lapses all isolate work stops, and the last time it stopped for two weeks.

wronglyLimitedItems.text: The reagent invoice is filed and the budget line for the next quarter is set.

missed.text: The two cells for the first run of the new year are already covered, nothing more goes out for them.
Our industry partner holds the shared results back from any paper until the middle of 2027.
The partner company transfers the agreed sum for the data in one instalment when the first delivery goes out.
The quarterly paperwork for cells and reagents has to go in a fortnight before the next slot at the core.
First the one who holds the budget puts a name on the form, then the office turns it into an order.
Lose the committee sign off and the bench side of the project is frozen for a fortnight, with a visit before anyone starts again.
One of the students will face the committee a term later than planned because the comparison is not done.
